name: Footer shows copyright and developer credit
description: The footer must show the copyright line with the current year and BobaSticker branding, plus a credit link to the developer's Instagram profile.

planSteps.description: Scroll to the bottom of the page
The footer shows the text 'BobaSticker' and a copyright line '© 2026 BobaSticker. Dibuat sepenuh hati bareng kopi dan Mendoan.'
The footer has a developer credit with a round avatar image that links to an Instagram profile URL
